tagline: Create, track and send purchase orders from one simple app inside Google Sheets. Thank you for your purchase!
how_steps: Click the link in your PDF → Make a copy. It's yours in Google Drive.
Pick a vendor, add line items - totals, tax and PO numbers are automatic.
Mark it sent, received and paid - then save it as a PDF for your vendor.
guide_sections: Click the button above while signed in to Google. Your own copy is saved to your Google Drive - rename it anything you like. Then click the Purchase Order Management Dashboard tab at the bottom: that's your app.

Open the Company tab and replace the sample details with your company name, address, phone, email and website. Set your Tax Rate as a decimal (8.25% = 0.0825, or 0 if you don't charge tax) and your PO Prefix (for example PO- or ACME-). These appear on every purchase order.
In the app, open Vendors and click + Add Vendor. Enter the name, contact, email, phone, address and payment terms. Each vendor card shows its total spend and order history.

Click + New PO. Choose a vendor (their contact and payment terms appear on the right), set the order and expected delivery dates, then add line items with + Add Line: item/SKU, description, quantity and unit price. Subtotal, tax, shipping and total calculate live, and the PO number is assigned automatically. Click Create PO.

Open any PO from Orders and use the quick buttons: Mark as Sent when you send it, Mark as Received when it arrives (received quantities fill in automatically), and Mark as Paid when you pay the invoice. For a partial delivery, set the status to Partially Received and type the quantities you received.

The Dashboard shows open orders, spend this month, unpaid balance and overdue deliveries, plus a Needs Immediate Attention list, monthly spend, POs by status and your top vendors. Click anything to jump to it.
Send a PO to your vendor

Open the PO and click Print / Save as PDF (or open Print View), then press Ctrl+P (Windows) or Cmd+P (Mac). In the print window: set Destination to Save as PDF, open More settings, uncheck Headers and footers (removes the web address and date), check Background graphics (keeps the colors), and set Scale to about 75-80 so the whole PO fits on the page. Save, then attach the PDF to an email to your vendor.

The sample company and orders show how everything works. When you're ready, delete the sample orders from the app (open a PO → Delete) or clear the sample rows in the POs, PO Lines and Vendors tabs - keep row 1 (the headers). Your dashboard updates instantly.
tip: The app works best in Chrome on a computer. On a phone, open your sheet in your mobile browser rather than the Sheets app. Chrome remembers your print settings, so you only set them once.
faq: Do I need a paid Google plan?
No - it works with a free Google account.
Yes - share your copy like any Google Sheet. Anyone with edit access can create and update POs.
Can I change the PO numbers?
Yes - change the PO Prefix on the Company tab. New POs continue from your highest number.
Can I change the app's design?
The layout is fixed, but your company details, vendors, orders and line items are fully editable.
